title: Setup-wizard device pre-fill refusal renders its description without the placeholders its text reads
claim: When the setup wizard's device pre-fill page refuses a save (e.g. dhw_min_too_close), the re-rendered form supplies only name_matched/matched_sources, so en.json's config.step.device_prefill description, which reads {found} and {backup_heater_type}, cannot render, and matched_sources is re-told as '–' for a device the preview resolved; the options flow's sibling page keeps them.
mechanism: config_flow.HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow.async_step_device_prefill's refusal branch calls self._device_prefill_form(_prefill_schema(keys, saved), {}, errors): the notes the preview computed (modbus_prefill.notes + device_prefill.disclaimer(resolution)) are not kept, so only device_prefill.disclaimer()'s empty-resolution defaults reach description_placeholders. The options sibling (async_step_modbus_prefill) keeps notes in self._prefill and passes them on refusal. Home Assistant's frontend formats the description with IntlMessageFormat and shows 'Translation error: ...' when a variable is missing.

evidence.unit: missing placeholders on the config refusal render (found, backup_heater_type); 1 en.json string fails str.format_map; 3 placeholders changed vs the preview
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: mock.patch.object HeatPumpOptimizerConfigFlow._device_prefill_form so the refusal keeps the page's read-notes ({**modbus_prefill.notes({}), **notes}), the shape of the options page's kept self._prefill notes

metric_definition: Placeholders named by en.json config.step.device_prefill (plus the rendered error strings) absent from the returned form's description_placeholders, on the refusal render.
phenomenon_property: Every render of a flow step (first show, preview and every refusal re-render) supplies every placeholder that step's en.json strings and its rendered error strings name, with the same values the page last showed for the read it describes.
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s3/prefill_placeholders.py (arms: config pick/preview/refusal, options refusal); the call sites are `grep -n "_device_prefill_form(\|_prefill_form(" custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/config_flow.py`

null_control.note: The same device and the same refused value on the options flow's modbus_prefill page supply every placeholder; the config page's own pick and preview renders do too. Only the config refusal drops them.

reproduction_steps: Seed a FakeHass with the tuya_heat_pump_000004k4z6 fixture device (dev_rotenso) and its live states.
Config flow: async_step_device_prefill(None), then pick the device, then submit {dhw_setpoint: 49} (45 degC minimum + 5 K margin refuses it).
Compare result['description_placeholders'] against the {..} names in en.json config.step.device_prefill: found and backup_heater_type are missing; matched_sources reads '–'.
proposed_fix_scope: config_flow.py: keep the preview's notes (and sourced disclaimer) on the config flow's pre-fill state the way the options flow's self._prefill tuple does, and pass them to _device_prefill_form on refusal.
